text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...!
I couldn't reach it, huh.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, but...
I think I had... a pretty good time running—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOO!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I was completely mesmerized by Seiun Sky's running!
Was she always that amazing!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
If it's her,
she looks like she could really shake up the Senior Class...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky! Show us another exciting race!

Cheers, applause, and stirring murmurs.
Rather than the victorious Umamusume, all eyes were drawn to Seiun Sky's run.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...What if I'd won after all that?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Haha...!
In that case, next time, for sure—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: —Sei-chan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Good work.
That was a fantastic run, Sei-chan!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks.
You too, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I want to run with Sei-chan again.
Please let me stay your rival next year too!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, pardon my presumption, but—
yep, let's run together again!

"Rivals who gave their all across the Classics praise one another.
The venue erupts into even greater excitement at the beautiful sight...
and the 'Kikuka Sho' comes to a glorious close."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'm so, so sorry! What a disappointment!
I couldn't pull it off in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Man, great work out there.
Guess I really wasn't a "strong" Umamusume after all.
choice_data_list: Still, you managed to captivate everyone.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
I wonder... if I was able to do something fun.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Still, did you see Spe-chan's expression?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's like she's saying, "I'm not going down here!"
Good grief, looks like she's gonna give me a hard time again~.

Seiun Sky wryly smiled as he spoke,
looking like he was secretly having fun.
And on the way back from the race—Seiun Sky was surrounded by a crowd of fans.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's Seiun Sky!
Today's race was amazing!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to the Arima Kinen too~!
Good luck out there!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen?
Am I... running in it?

The year-end Grand Prix race, the Arima Kinen.
While it's a goal for many Umamusume, Seiun Sky hasn't decided on her next race yet.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Wait, but she was so strong today too,
I naturally thought she'd go, but...

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: "Let's keep up this momentum, beat Grass Wonder, and prove we're the strongest of our generation!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Huh~, so Grass-chan
plans to enter.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I see...
'Strongest of our generation,' huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, with that in mind,
shall we go ahead and enter the Arima Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"My schedule after this was totally clear anyway,
so I figured it'd be just right~"
choice_data_list: It's a tough lineup, but are you going to be okay?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my, are you really saying that now?
Even though we were aiming for the Triple Crown together♪"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, it'll work out somehow!
We've always managed to pull through before, after all.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...I have a feeling there's still plenty of fun to be had♪

And so, spurred on by the fans' expectations,
our next goal was set as the Arima Kinen.
